title: Merre tovább? (Where I Go From Here: Gárdonyi Géza)
grammar: B1 Subordination Synthesis & Autonomous Expression in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say that I can manage on my own in Hungarian.
I can explain something about Hungarian history in my own words.
I can use four words for language proficiency, perspective, further development and native-speaker level.
I can read the inspiring heroic oath of Dobó István from Gárdonyi's Egri csillagok.
